FISHING LICENCE · BELGIUM

Belgium fishing licence

Freshwater permits differ between Flanders, Wallonia and Brussels. In Wallonia, most rivers outside the public navigable waterways also require a club card or the fishing-right holder's permission.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers in Wallonia's rivers, canals and connected lakes need a Walloon permit.
  • Use the separate regional system for Flanders or Brussels.

Who doesn’t

  • Wallonia: isolated ponds without natural fish passage to a river do not require the regional permit.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Wallonia short-stay permitany14 consecutive daysSee official site

Extra stamps and permits

  • Wallonia club card or owner's permission
    Required outside the public navigable waterways when the water belongs to a club or another fishing-right holder.

Saltwater

Sea fishing has separate coastal rules. RecFishing reports are required for the specified sea bass, bluefin tuna and European eel catches.

Rules visitors should know

  • In Wallonia, carry the permit and valid ID.
  • Choose a permit that covers bank, boat, wading or night fishing as applicable.
  • Follow the official RecFishing reporting rules for the listed marine species.

How to buy

Buy the Walloon permit online at permisdepeche.be. Use the relevant regional authority for Flanders or Brussels.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Belgium?

Freshwater permits differ between Flanders, Wallonia and Brussels. In Wallonia, most rivers outside the public navigable waterways also require a club card or the fishing-right holder's permission.

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Belgium?

Buy the Walloon permit online at permisdepeche.be. Use the relevant regional authority for Flanders or Brussels.
